name: theme-switcher
description: A source-owned Dioxus-only palette switcher for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus-only extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA`-style per design.md §7b (no shadcn/dioxus-components catalog counterpart in statics/component_compatibility.json). A distilled palette picker (Slate/Blue/Violet/Emerald/Rose/Amber presets recoloring --primary/--primary-foreground and their Tailwind aliases) productizing the concept prototyped in apps/playground's advanced customization tray, which keeps its own full 28-token editor unchanged.
documentation.accessibility: Composes `theme_mode`'s `ThemeMode`/`ResolvedTheme` resolution (`packages/adico-primitives/src/theme_mode.rs`) behind a styled `Button`-like trigger; its accessibility surface is a native button's.
documentation.keyboard: Native button activation (Enter/Space); no custom keyboard layer.
